The repository README and GLB asset.extras both explicitly retain Geoffrey Marchal's source and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Original upstream scan contains approximately 375,700 triangles.
The GitHub derivative was simplified to 29,997 triangles, centered/resized, textures removed, and meshopt compressed.
This workspace copy was losslessly meshopt decoded for Blender compatibility; source attribution and licensing extras retained.
Decoded file: venus_medici_ncsa_decoded.glb
Decoded size: 364920 bytes
No artistic remodeling was performed in this workspace.

Verified 2026-10-18:
- Primary Sketchfab indexed record describes the Royal Cast Collection / Uffizi inv.224 scan and CC Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike.
- Uffizi official record confirms the Medici Venus artwork, pudica pose, height153cm and inventory224.
- Blender 4.5.9 import and four view render confirm complete arms and dolphin support.
- Actual Blender coordinates after applying imported transforms: Z up, front toward -Y; no extra rotation needed.
- Mesh: 15288 vertices, 29997 triangles.
- Bounds min: (-0.4195733070, -0.3803622723, 0.00004816055)
- Bounds max: (0.4193555117, 0.3804898262, 2.5999896526)
- Height: 2.5999414921
- Normalize: subtract X/Y bounding-box center and minimumZ, then multiply coordinates by desiredHeight / 2.5999414921.
- Front render: venus_medici_four_views.png, leftmost view is default orientation. Following views rotate +90, +180, +270 degrees around Blender Z.

Repository README as obtained:
# The Black Lodge

An interactive isometric 3D miniature of the Black Lodge from Twin Peaks.

Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, and Tailwind CSS.

"Venus Medici" ([https://skfb.ly/SMr9](https://skfb.ly/SMr9)) by Geoffrey Marchal is licensed under CC Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike ([http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)).

The model was simplified, resized, and compressed, and its textures were removed. This modified model is distributed under the same CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
